description: Read-only Yahoo Finance company datasets. External network access; no orders or arbitrary code. Caller must authorize provider access.

symbol.description: Exact Yahoo ticker. TSM and 2330.TW identify different listings.

range.description: History only. Defaults to 1Y; MAX uses monthly observations.

output.financials: Statements preserve provider keys, units, currency, fiscal period ends and reporting frequency.
output.market: Latest available regular-session data; not labeled real-time. History includes OHLCV and corporate actions when provided.
